LIBR00001.description: Read offline Wikipedia and Kiwix collections, ebooks, comics and documents, and listen to audiobooks on your PS4.

JFPS40000.description: Browse and play movies, TV shows and other media from your own Jellyfin server on your PS4.

APOL00004.description: Manage PS4 game saves: download saves, export backups, apply patches and resign saves for your account.

CHTM00777.description: Download and manage cheat files and game patches for GoldHEN on PS4.

RMTC00001.description: Browse and transfer files between your PS4 and remote servers, network shares and cloud storage.

BREW04327.description: Play music and videos from local drives and network media servers, with plugins for internet radio, podcasts and other online media.

BREW04328.description: Watch TV from your Tvheadend server on your console. Requires a configured Tvheadend server on your network.

NPXS39041.description: Browse, download and update homebrew applications on a jailbroken PS4.

DVLX00001.description: Play Diablo and its Hellfire expansion using a modern recreation of the game engine. Requires your own original game data.

FALL20002.description: Play Fallout 2 on PS4 with gamepad controls using the Community Edition engine. Requires your own Fallout 2 game data.

SAIR00001.description: Play Sonic 3 & Knuckles with widescreen support and enhancements from Angel Island Revisited. Requires compatible original game data.

DLPH00010.description: Run GameCube and Wii games on PS4 using the Dolphin emulator, with per-game settings. Compatibility and performance vary by game.

PCSX20007.description: An experimental PlayStation 2 emulator for PS4, based on PCSX2. Compatibility and performance vary by game.

DCLD00001.description: Play Dark Cloud natively on PS4 through the Chronicle engine recreation. Requires your own Dark Cloud disc image.

TMPS10021.description: Play Gothic II: Night of the Raven using the OpenGothic engine recreation. Requires your own original game data.

QUAK03000.description: Play Quake III Arena on PS4 using the ioQuake3 engine. Requires your own Quake III game data.
